name: Amime
description: A fishing net of sagging arcs crossing into curved meshes, with a colored knot tied at the top of every mesh.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at -50% 0, transparent 92.5%, #000 92.5% 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at 50% 0, transparent 92.5%, #000 92.5% 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at 150% 0, transparent 92.5%, #000 92.5% 100%, transparent 100%); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at -50% 0, transparent 92.5%, #000 92.5% 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at 50% 0, transparent 92.5%, #000 92.5% 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 100% at 150% 0, transparent 92.5%, #000 92.5% 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; width: 14%; height: 14%; margin: -7% 0 0 -7%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
